findings.F1: The test's main measure is zero, not a short positive: over all four folds the mean excess 7-day return of the 93 cases with a positive forecast is -0.12 % with t -0.12 (64 days). The Spearman of 0.03 barely passes. More data on the same six coins would not move a result that has no sign.
findings.F2: In folds B and C the in-profile rises lean the other way. The 20 cases with a positive 7-day scaled rise have an excess 7-day return of -2.7 % (t -1.86 with the cases of one day together, 14 days). Their Spearman between the size of the rise and the excess is -0.27, against the graded continuation the idea predicts.
findings.F3: The grading runs against the idea. In the profile, rises of 0 to 0.75 usual swings are followed by -1.6 % over 7 days (16 cases, t -1.06). Rises of 0.75 to 1.5 swings are followed by -8.2 % (3 cases, t -2.97), and the one case above 1.5 swings by -4.9 %. The larger the scaled rise, the worse the next week, not better.
findings.F4: The effect is not hidden at another horizon. In the profile the scaled rise is followed by +0.1 % over 3 days (35 cases at 0 to 0.75 swings, t 0.07). Over 14 days the rises give +4.6 % at 0 to 0.75 swings (10 cases, t 0.89) and -7.4 % for the one case above 0.75 swings, with no grading.
findings.F5: The mirror side does not carry the theme either. In the profile, 7-day falls are followed by a continuation of only +2.0 % in the fall's direction (32 cases, t 0.38, 21 days), and the Spearman of fall size with the continuation is negative (-0.20).
findings.F6: The coin is not split into a part where the effect shows. By coin, the in-profile rises are negative or near zero on every coin: BTC -4.5 %, ETH -5.9 %, ZEC -6.8 % (t -2.40), LTC, XMR and XRP within ±0.8 %. By year they are negative in every year shown: 2019 -3.0 %, 2020 -3.6 %, 2021 -1.8 %.
findings.F7: The only positive pockets lie outside the theme's choppy, agitated market, and they rest on few days. Rises of 0.75 to 1.5 swings in choppy but calm markets give +13.8 % (12 cases on 9 days, t 2.58). Rises above 1.5 swings across all markets outside the profile give +3.8 % (96 cases, t 1.91). Neither is a narrower case of the theme's situation.
findings.F8: Step 5's size measure is small and cannot be told from zero. The unusual move is +0.72 % per case over 7 days, a strength of 0.051 of a usual 12.44 % move, with t 0.84 over 165 days. Most of the book's +1.69 % total move per case is the coins' normal drift of +0.97 %, which is why the book's Sharpe trails holding by 0.03.

no_ideas: The theme's effect is not in the data. In a choppy, agitated market the past week's rise is followed by an excess next-week return of zero over all folds (-0.12 %, t -0.12, F1). Where it can be seen, it leans to reversal, and more so the larger the rise (F2, F3). This holds at every horizon, on the mirror side, on every coin and in every year (F4 to F6). The only continuation found lives outside the theme's market (F7).
